code: # HAND-MAINTAINED — scripts/build-places.sh does NOT write this file.
# The everyday English name is precisely what no upstream source carries:
# iso-codes ships the formal "Korea, Republic of" and GeoNames has no
# country-level English alternates worth merging, so there is nothing to
# generate this from. Search-only, never displayed.
# Only names the catalogue cannot already reach. Comma-inverted and
# bracketed forms ("Republic of Korea", "Cataluna") are DERIVED in
# Places.nameVariants — do not list them here.
# Lines without a tab are ignored; the first line is the header.
